GSEA 分组渐变山脊图

将 leading-edge 基因分布、NES 方向与 padj 显著性合为一张分组山脊图，正负富集两端可配置。

图源：Figure_E_GSEA_ridge_gold.pdf

分析流程与参数

从专题 README 抽取；原文顺序保留，未跑过的部分照实标注。

把 GSEA 的核心富集基因分布、通路富集方向和校正后显著性压进同一张分组山脊图：
山脊按 NES 渐变，圆点大小编码 -log10(padj)，并用双向色条标出正负 NES 对应哪一组。

分析流程

  1. 确认 DESeq2 的对比方向和分组语义；需要反向时只翻 stat / log2FC。
  2. 从 MSigDB、KEGG 或自定义 GMT 取基因集，统一成 Symbol。
  3. 运行 fgsea()，保留 NES、pval、padj、size 与 leadingEdge。
  4. 把每条通路的 leading-edge 基因展开为长表，并带上通路级统计量。
  5. 绘图：按 NES 从高到低排通路；x 轴按 leading-edge 极值对称扩展 5%。
  6. 用单一路径函数 pall() 同时计算山脊、圆点和 NES 色条颜色。

关键参数

参数 默认 说明
--positive-label Positive NES NES 正端对应的组名，显示在色条上方
--negative-label Negative NES NES 负端对应的组名，显示在色条下方
--positive-color #608DC3 正 NES 端颜色；山脊、圆点、色条共用
--negative-color #BE5A93 负 NES 端颜色；山脊、圆点、色条共用
--dot-side left 显著性圆点放面板左侧或右侧
--width-cm / --height-cm 9.53 / 7.7 原图物理尺寸
--base-size 6 字号基准；更改画布大小时一并调整
--cairo 关闭 中文或非 WinAnsi 字符必须开启，否则 PDF 字形会丢失

复现边界

  • 这是转录组富集结果的可视化，不证明通路活性、蛋白变化或因果关系。
  • leadingEdge 由 fgsea 的排序统计量决定；更换基因集版本、ID 映射或排名会改变曲线。
  • 同一通路的 NES / padj 必须来自同一次 fgsea 结果，不能把不同分析批次混拼。
  • 若 padj 太小导致点径达到上限，应调高 --padj-top 或在图注说明截断。
  • 原项目图只适合作样式与数据结构参考；其生物学结论仍需回到实验设计判断。
展开其余 7 个章节（工具栈、数据格式、可视化方法、参考文献等）

这是什么

这是 20260811_zmxFig单细胞Bulk 项目 Figure E gold 版的可复用实现。原图用于比较
Treatment 与 High stiffness（4v4 bulk RNA-seq），本专题把项目专属的路径、
分组名和颜色全部提成参数，接口编号为图册 plot62。

  • 每条通路的 x 分布来自 fgsea leadingEdge 基因的真实 log2FoldChange
  • 山脊填充、圆点和 NES 色条使用同一个颜色函数，避免三套色标漂移
  • alpha 随 |NES| 变化；点径随 -log10(padj) 变化
  • x 轴自适应且以 0 对称，极端 log2FC 不会被截断
  • 默认只导出 PDF 矢量图

输入

绘图脚本吃长表。每行是一个通路的 leading-edge 基因，同一通路的 NES / padj
重复即可：

pathway,label,gene,log2fc,NES,padj
KEGG_TIGHT_JUNCTION,Tight junction,TJP1,-1.23,1.43,0.012
KEGG_TIGHT_JUNCTION,Tight junction,OCLN,-0.88,1.43,0.012

必需列：pathway、gene、log2fc、NES、padj；label 可选，缺省用
pathway 原值。每个通路至少 3 个有限 log2fc；同一通路的 NES / padj 必须一致。

01_prepare_gsea_leading_edge.R 可从 DESeq2 结果 + GMT 生成这张长表，并保留
fgsea 的 p 值、padj 和通路大小。仓库内 example_data/ 已附 8 通路示例，可直接复现。

目录

文件 说明
01_prepare_gsea_leading_edge.R DESeq2 表 + GMT → fgsea → 标准化长表
02_plot_gsea_grouped_ridge.R 标准化长表 → 分组渐变山脊图 PDF
pathways_example.tsv 示例的 8 条通路 ID、显示名和来源
example_data/gsea_leading_edge_example.csv 609 行 leading-edge 示例数据
example_data/gsea_pathway_summary_example.csv 8 条通路的 NES、p、padj、size
Figure_E_GSEA_ridge_gold.pdf 原始项目成图预览（本地 PDF，不入 Git）

复现

只重画示例图：

Rscript 02_plot_gsea_grouped_ridge.R \
  --input example_data/gsea_leading_edge_example.csv \
  --out Figure_E_GSEA_ridge_gold_rebuilt.pdf \
  --title "GSEA: Treatment vs High stiffness" \
  --positive-label "Treatment" \
  --negative-label "High stiffness"

从自己的 DESeq2 结果和 GMT 开始：

Rscript 01_prepare_gsea_leading_edge.R \
  --deg results/DESeq2.tsv \
  --gmt pathways.gmt \
  --labels pathway_labels.tsv \
  --flip \
  --out gsea_leading_edge.csv \
  --summary-out gsea_pathway_summary.csv

Rscript 02_plot_gsea_grouped_ridge.R \
  --input gsea_leading_edge.csv \
  --out GSEA_grouped_ridge.pdf

--flip 会把 stat 与 log2FoldChange 同时取负，用于仅改变比较方向、不重跑
DESeq2 的情形。p 值、padj 与 NES 的绝对值不因翻转而改变。

接口（plot62）

图册编号：plot62；MCP 工具：plot62_gsea_grouped_ridge。

render_plot  method_id="plot62"
  arguments: {
    "csv_path": "/path/to/gsea_leading_edge.csv",
    "columns": {
      "pathway": "pathway", "label": "label", "gene": "gene",
      "log2fc": "log2fc", "NES": "NES", "padj": "padj"
    },
    "title": "GSEA: Treatment vs High stiffness",
    "positive_label": "Treatment",
    "negative_label": "High stiffness"
  }

接口只做绘图，不做富集统计。validate_inputs 先检查列与行数，再调用 render_plot。
MCP 默认输出 PDF；网页缩略图由图册构建器从 PDF 派生，不把 PNG 当分析产物。

验证记录

2026-10-29 在 R 4.5.1 实测：

  • 示例长表 609 行、8 条通路，所有 leading-edge 基因都有有限 log2FC
  • fgsea 复算得到 8 条通路的 NES、padj 与原项目 README 一致
  • PDF 单页成功生成，x 轴范围断言通过，无 leading-edge 越界
  • 8 条通路的填充色与圆点颜色逐一相等，正/负端点色与图例一致
  • 图册导入后检查了 PDF 栅格化缩略图与详情页代码块

来源与差异

来源：~/hz/20260811_zmxFig单细胞Bulk/02_Bulk刚度转录组/删A4B4-20260804/2.13_0802出图/图E_fgsea/Figure_E_GSEA_ridge_gold.R

相对原脚本：

  • 去掉项目绝对路径、固定通路列表和固定分组名
  • 把数据准备与绘图拆成两步，支持任意 GMT 和任意两组比较
  • 增加输入形状、唯一元信息、x 轴覆盖和颜色一致性断言
  • 默认保持原图的 9.53 × 7.7 cm、Helvetica 与 PDF 输出

分析代码

2 个源码文件，按目录顺序；本机绝对路径已替换为 ~。 代码可复制，但需要按自己的数据改路径与参数。

01_prepare_gsea_leading_edge.r r · 6504 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# DESeq2 table + GMT -> fgsea -> standardized leading-edge long table.
#
# The output is intentionally plot-ready: pathway metadata is repeated on every
# gene row so downstream rendering does not need to join multiple tables.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(fgsea)
  library(readr)
})

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

has_flag <- function(flag) flag %in% args

get_option <- function(flag, default = NULL) {
  hit <- match(flag, args)
  if (is.na(hit)) return(default)
  if (hit == length(args) || startsWith(args[hit + 1], "--")) {
    stop("参数 ", flag, " 后缺少值。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  args[hit + 1]
}

if (has_flag("--help")) {
  cat(
    "Usage:\n",
    "  Rscript 01_prepare_gsea_leading_edge.R --deg FILE --gmt FILE --out FILE [options]\n\n",
    "Required:\n",
    "  --deg FILE             DESeq2 result table (CSV or TSV)\n",
    "  --gmt FILE             GMT gene sets using the same gene IDs as --gene-col\n",
    "  --out FILE             standardized leading-edge CSV\n\n",
    "Options:\n",
    "  --labels FILE          TSV with pathway,label columns\n",
    "  --summary-out FILE     pathway-level summary CSV\n",
    "  --gene-col NAME        default gene_name\n",
    "  --stat-col NAME        default stat\n",
    "  --lfc-col NAME         default log2FoldChange\n",
    "  --padj-col NAME        default padj\n",
    "  --flip                 multiply stat and log2FoldChange by -1\n",
    "  --min-size N           default 5\n",
    "  --max-size N           default 500\n",
    "  --seed N               default 20260804\n",
    "  --help                 show this help\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  quit(status = 0)
}

required <- c("--deg", "--gmt", "--out")
missing_args <- required[!vapply(required, has_flag, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_args)) {
  stop("缺少参数：", paste(missing_args, collapse = ", "), "。用 --help 查看用法。",
       call. = FALSE)
}

deg_path <- get_option("--deg")
gmt_path <- get_option("--gmt")
out_path <- get_option("--out")
labels_path <- get_option("--labels")
summary_path <- get_option("--summary-out")
gene_col <- get_option("--gene-col", "gene_name")
stat_col <- get_option("--stat-col", "stat")
lfc_col <- get_option("--lfc-col", "log2FoldChange")
padj_col <- get_option("--padj-col", "padj")
min_size <- as.integer(get_option("--min-size", "5"))
max_size <- as.integer(get_option("--max-size", "500"))
seed <- as.integer(get_option("--seed", "20260804"))
flip <- has_flag("--flip")

for (path in c(deg_path, gmt_path)) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("输入文件不存在：", path, call. = FALSE)
}
if (!is.null(labels_path) && !file.exists(labels_path)) {
  stop("标签文件不存在：", labels_path, call. = FALSE)
}

deg <- read_tsv(deg_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
required_cols <- c(gene_col, stat_col, lfc_col, padj_col)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(deg))
if (length(missing_cols)) {
  stop("DESeq2 表缺少列：", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "；现有列：", paste(names(deg), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

deg <- deg[!is.na(deg[[gene_col]]) & nzchar(as.character(deg[[gene_col]])), ]
ranks <- as.numeric(deg[[stat_col]])
names(ranks) <- as.character(deg[[gene_col]])
lfc <- as.numeric(deg[[lfc_col]])
names(lfc) <- as.character(deg[[gene_col]])

keep <- is.finite(ranks) & !duplicated(names(ranks))
ranks <- ranks[keep]
lfc <- lfc[keep]
if (flip) {
  ranks <- -ranks
  lfc <- -lfc
}
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

pathways <- fgsea::gmtPathways(gmt_path)
if (!length(pathways)) stop("GMT 里没有读到任何基因集。", call. = FALSE)
if (anyDuplicated(names(pathways))) {
  stop("GMT 里有重复通路名，先合并或重命名。", call. = FALSE)
}

pathways <- lapply(pathways, function(genes) {
  unique(intersect(as.character(genes), names(ranks)))
})
pathways <- pathways[lengths(pathways) >= min_size & lengths(pathways) <= max_size]
if (!length(pathways)) {
  stop("GMT 与排名没有交集，或所有通路都不满足 size 范围。", call. = FALSE)
}

labels <- setNames(names(pathways), names(pathways))
if (!is.null(labels_path)) {
  label_table <- read_tsv(labels_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("pathway", "label") %in% names(label_table))) {
    stop("--labels 必须是含 pathway,label 两列的 TSV。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  label_table$pathway <- as.character(label_table$pathway)
  label_table$label <- as.character(label_table$label)
  if (anyDuplicated(label_table$pathway)) {
    stop("标签文件里 pathway 重复。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  hit <- label_table$pathway[label_table$pathway %in% names(labels)]
  labels[hit] <- label_table$label[match(hit, label_table$pathway)]
}
if (anyDuplicated(unname(labels))) {
  stop("显示标签重复，山脊 y 轴无法区分通路。", call. = FALSE)
}

set.seed(seed)
fg <- as.data.frame(fgsea(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats = ranks,
  minSize = min_size,
  maxSize = max_size,
  eps = 0
))
if (!nrow(fg)) stop("fgsea 没有返回任何结果。", call. = FALSE)

valid_ids <- names(pathways)[names(pathways) %in% fg$pathway]
fg <- fg[match(valid_ids, fg$pathway), ]

long_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fg)), function(i) {
  genes <- as.character(fg$leadingEdge[[i]])
  data.frame(
    pathway = fg$pathway[i],
    label = unname(labels[fg$pathway[i]]),
    gene = genes,
    log2fc = unname(lfc[genes]),
    NES = fg$NES[i],
    pval = fg$pval[i],
    padj = fg$padj[i],
    size = fg$size[i],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
long <- do.call(rbind, long_rows)
long <- long[is.finite(long$log2fc), ]
if (!nrow(long)) stop("所有 leading-edge 基因都缺少有限 log2FC。", call. = FALSE)

summary <- data.frame(
  pathway = fg$pathway,
  label = unname(labels[fg$pathway]),
  NES = fg$NES,
  pval = fg$pval,
  padj = fg$padj,
  size = fg$size,
  leading_edge_n = lengths(fg$leadingEdge),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(long, out_path, na = "")
if (!is.null(summary_path)) {
  dir.create(dirname(summary_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_csv(summary, summary_path, na = "")
}

cat("fgsea leading-edge table written: ", out_path, "\n", sep = "")
cat("pathways=", nrow(summary), " genes_in_long_table=", nrow(long),
    " flipped=", flip, "\n", sep = "")
print(summary[, c("pathway", "NES", "pval", "padj", "size", "leading_edge_n")],
      row.names = FALSE)
02_plot_gsea_grouped_ridge.r r · 14962 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# Plot a GSEA grouped gradient ridge figure from a standardized long table.
# Scientific output is PDF-only; the gallery rasterizes a preview separately.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggridges)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

has_flag <- function(flag) flag %in% args

get_option <- function(flag, default = NULL) {
  hit <- match(flag, args)
  if (is.na(hit)) return(default)
  if (hit == length(args) || startsWith(args[hit + 1], "--")) {
    stop("参数 ", flag, " 后缺少值。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  args[hit + 1]
}

script_dir <- local({
  file_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE), value = TRUE)
  if (length(file_arg)) {
    dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", file_arg[1])))
  } else {
    getwd()
  }
})

default_input <- file.path(
  script_dir,
  "example_data",
  "gsea_leading_edge_example.csv"
)

if (has_flag("--help")) {
  cat(
    "Usage:\n",
    "  Rscript 02_plot_gsea_grouped_ridge.R [options]\n\n",
    "Options:\n",
    "  --input FILE           standardized long table\n",
    "  --out FILE             output PDF (default Figure_E_GSEA_grouped_ridge.pdf)\n",
    "  --title TEXT           plot title\n",
    "  --positive-label TEXT  group label at positive NES end\n",
    "  --negative-label TEXT  group label at negative NES end\n",
    "  --positive-color HEX   default #608DC3\n",
    "  --negative-color HEX   default #BE5A93\n",
    "  --dot-side left|right  default left\n",
    "  --width-cm N           default 9.53\n",
    "  --height-cm N          default 7.7\n",
    "  --base-size N          default 6\n",
    "  --x-min N --x-max N    optional manual symmetric x limits\n",
    "  --padj-top N           optional upper limit for -log10(padj)\n",
    "  --cairo                use cairo_pdf for non-WinAnsi text\n",
    "  --help                 show this help\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  quit(status = 0)
}

input_path <- get_option("--input", default_input)
out_path <- get_option(
  "--out",
  file.path(script_dir, "Figure_E_GSEA_grouped_ridge.pdf")
)
title_main <- get_option("--title", "")
positive_label <- get_option("--positive-label", "Positive NES")
negative_label <- get_option("--negative-label", "Negative NES")
positive_color <- get_option("--positive-color", "#608DC3")
negative_color <- get_option("--negative-color", "#BE5A93")
dot_side <- tolower(get_option("--dot-side", "left"))
width_cm <- as.numeric(get_option("--width-cm", "9.53"))
height_cm <- as.numeric(get_option("--height-cm", "7.7"))
base_size <- as.numeric(get_option("--base-size", "6"))
x_min_user <- get_option("--x-min")
x_max_user <- get_option("--x-max")
padj_top_user <- get_option("--padj-top")
use_cairo <- has_flag("--cairo")

if (!file.exists(input_path)) stop("输入文件不存在：", input_path, call. = FALSE)
if (!grepl("\\.pdf$", out_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  stop("本脚本只输出 PDF；网页缩略图请交给图册构建器生成。", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!dot_side %in% c("left", "right")) {
  stop("--dot-side 只能是 left 或 right。", call. = FALSE)
}
if (width_cm <= 0 || height_cm <= 0 || base_size <= 0) {
  stop("画布尺寸和 --base-size 必须为正数。", call. = FALSE)
}

d <- read.csv(
  input_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

required_cols <- c("pathway", "gene", "log2fc", "NES", "padj")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols)) {
  stop("输入缺少列：", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "；现有列：", paste(names(d), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!"label" %in% names(d)) d$label <- d$pathway

d$pathway <- as.character(d$pathway)
d$label <- as.character(d$label)
d$gene <- as.character(d$gene)
d$log2fc <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$log2fc))
d$NES <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$NES))
d$padj <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$padj))

d$pathway[is.na(d$pathway) | !nzchar(d$pathway)] <- "Unnamed pathway"
d$label[is.na(d$label) | !nzchar(d$label)] <- d$pathway[is.na(d$label) | !nzchar(d$label)]
d <- d[is.finite(d$log2fc) & is.finite(d$NES) & is.finite(d$padj) & d$padj >= 0, ]
if (!nrow(d)) stop("没有同时具备有限 log2fc、NES、padj 的行。", call. = FALSE)

meta_rows <- lapply(split(d, d$pathway), function(block) {
  labels <- unique(block$label[nzchar(block$label)])
  if (length(labels) != 1L) {
    stop("通路 ", block$pathway[1], " 的 label 不唯一。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  nes <- unique(block$NES)
  padj <- unique(block$padj)
  if (length(nes) != 1L) {
    stop("通路 ", block$pathway[1], " 的 NES 不唯一。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (length(padj) != 1L) {
    stop("通路 ", block$pathway[1], " 的 padj 不唯一。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  data.frame(
    pathway = block$pathway[1],
    label = labels,
    NES = nes,
    padj = padj,
    n_gene = length(unique(block$gene)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
meta <- do.call(rbind, meta_rows)
rownames(meta) <- NULL
meta <- meta[meta$n_gene >= 3, ]
if (!nrow(meta)) stop("筛选后没有通路达到至少 3 个 leading-edge 基因。", call. = FALSE)
if (anyDuplicated(meta$label)) {
  stop("显示标签重复；请先把同名通路改成不同 label。", call. = FALSE)
}

d <- d[d$pathway %in% meta$pathway, ]
up_ids <- meta$pathway[meta$NES >= 0]
down_ids <- meta$pathway[meta$NES < 0]
up_ids <- up_ids[order(meta$NES[match(up_ids, meta$pathway)], decreasing = TRUE)]
down_ids <- down_ids[order(meta$NES[match(down_ids, meta$pathway)], decreasing = FALSE)]
ordered_top <- c(up_ids, down_ids)
ordered_ids <- rev(ordered_top)
label_map <- setNames(meta$label, meta$pathway)

if (!is.null(x_min_user) || !is.null(x_max_user)) {
  if (is.null(x_min_user) || is.null(x_max_user)) {
    stop("--x-min 与 --x-max 必须同时提供。", call. = FALSE)
  }
  x_min <- as.numeric(x_min_user)
  x_max <- as.numeric(x_max_user)
  if (!is.finite(x_min) || !is.finite(x_max) || x_min >= 0 || x_max <= 0) {
    stop("手动 x 范围必须满足 x_min < 0 < x_max。", call. = FALSE)
  }
} else {
  data_range <- range(d$log2fc, na.rm = TRUE)
  half <- max(abs(data_range)) * 1.05
  x_min <- -ceiling(half)
  x_max <- ceiling(half)
}
if (any(d$log2fc < x_min | d$log2fc > x_max)) {
  stop("有 leading-edge 基因落在 x 范围之外；调大范围后再画。", call. = FALSE)
}

d$Description <- factor(
  d$pathway,
  levels = ordered_ids,
  labels = unname(label_map[ordered_ids])
)
meta$Description <- factor(
  meta$pathway,
  levels = ordered_ids,
  labels = unname(label_map[ordered_ids])
)
meta$neglogpadj <- -log10(pmax(meta$padj, 1e-300))

nes_span <- max(abs(meta$NES), na.rm = TRUE)
nes_lim <- c(-1, 1) * max(1, ceiling(nes_span * 2) / 2)

pall <- function(x, lim = nes_lim) {
  t <- scales::rescale_mid(x, mid = 0, to = c(0, 1), from = lim)
  t <- pmin(1, pmax(0, t))
  scales::gradient_n_pal(
    c(negative_color, "white", positive_color),
    space = "Lab"
  )(t)
}

darken_hex <- function(hex, dl = 0.18, ds = 1.15) {
  vapply(hex, function(h) {
    v <- rgb2hsv(col2rgb(h)[, 1])
    hsv(h = v[1], s = min(1, v[2] * ds), v = max(0, v[3] - dl))
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

nes_hex <- setNames(pall(meta$NES), meta$pathway)
d$fill_hex <- unname(nes_hex[d$pathway])
d$line_col <- darken_hex(d$fill_hex)
meta$dot_col <- unname(nes_hex[meta$pathway])

check_fill <- tapply(d$fill_hex, d$pathway, function(x) unique(toupper(x)))
check_dot <- setNames(toupper(meta$dot_col), meta$pathway)
stopifnot(
  all(lengths(check_fill) == 1L),
  identical(as.vector(check_fill[names(check_dot)]), as.vector(check_dot)),
  pall(-nes_lim[2]) == negative_color,
  pall(0) == "#FFFFFF",
  pall(nes_lim[2]) == positive_color
)

padj_top <- if (!is.null(padj_top_user)) {
  as.numeric(padj_top_user)
} else {
  ceiling(max(meta$neglogpadj))
}
if (!is.finite(padj_top) || padj_top <= 0) {
  stop("--padj-top 必须为正数。", call. = FALSE)
}
padj_breaks <- pretty(range(meta$neglogpadj), n = 3)
padj_breaks <- padj_breaks[padj_breaks > 0 & padj_breaks <= padj_top]
if (!length(padj_breaks)) padj_breaks <- signif(max(meta$neglogpadj), 2)

beta_lab <- function(x) {
  lapply(x, function(s) {
    if (!grepl("\u03b2", s, fixed = TRUE)) return(s)
    parts <- strsplit(s, "\u03b2", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    expr <- NULL
    for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
      if (i > 1) {
        expr <- if (is.null(expr)) quote(beta) else bquote(.(expr) * beta)
      }
      if (nzchar(parts[i])) {
        expr <- if (is.null(expr)) parts[i] else bquote(.(expr) * .(parts[i]))
      }
    }
    expr
  })
}

dot_x <- if (dot_side == "left") x_min + 0.3 else x_max - 0.3
y_size <- 5.2 / 6 * base_size
y_text <- 5.0 / 6 * base_size
x_title <- 5.6 / 6 * base_size
title_size <- 7.2 / 6 * base_size

p_ridge <- ggplot(d, aes(x = log2fc, y = Description)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1.5,
    aes(fill = I(fill_hex), color = I(line_col), alpha = abs(NES)),
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.45, 0.85), guide = "none") +
  geom_point(
    data = meta,
    aes(x = dot_x, y = Description, color = I(dot_col), size = neglogpadj),
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.40)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(0.8, 2.2),
    limits = c(0, padj_top),
    breaks = padj_breaks,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = if (diff(c(x_min, x_max)) <= 20) {
      seq(floor(x_min), ceiling(x_max), 1)
    } else {
      scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)(c(x_min, x_max))
    },
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = beta_lab) +
  labs(x = expression(Log[2] ~ Fold ~ Change), y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "black", size = y_size, margin = margin(r = 2)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = y_text),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = x_title, margin = margin(t = 1)),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)
  )

leg_x <- 0
leg_w <- 0.13
leg_text_x <- 0.40
leg_arrow_x <- 0.95
leg_xmax <- max(
  3.30,
  1.20 + max(nchar(c(positive_label, negative_label))) * 0.13
)
arrow_head <- 0.035
arrow_dx <- 0.05
leg_title_size <- 1.55 / 6 * base_size
leg_text_size <- 1.55 / 6 * base_size
leg_group_size <- 1.50 / 6 * base_size

nes_seq <- seq(nes_lim[1], nes_lim[2], length.out = 300)
grad_df <- data.frame(y = seq(0, 1, length.out = 300), hex = pall(nes_seq))
nes_break_df <- data.frame(z = seq(ceiling(nes_lim[1]), floor(nes_lim[2]), 1))
nes_break_df$yfrac <- (nes_break_df$z - nes_lim[1]) / diff(nes_lim)

p_leg_nes <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = grad_df,
    aes(x = leg_x, y = y, fill = I(hex)),
    width = leg_w * 2,
    height = 1 / 299
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nes_break_df,
    aes(x = leg_text_x, y = yfrac, label = z),
    hjust = 0,
    size = leg_text_size,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = leg_arrow_x,
    xend = leg_arrow_x,
    y = 0,
    yend = 1,
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = leg_arrow_x,
    xend = leg_arrow_x - arrow_dx,
    y = 1,
    yend = 1 - arrow_head * 2,
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = leg_arrow_x,
    xend = leg_arrow_x + arrow_dx,
    y = 1,
    yend = 1 - arrow_head * 2,
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = leg_arrow_x,
    xend = leg_arrow_x - arrow_dx,
    y = 0,
    yend = arrow_head * 2,
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = leg_arrow_x,
    xend = leg_arrow_x + arrow_dx,
    y = 0,
    yend = arrow_head * 2,
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = leg_arrow_x + 0.12,
    y = 1,
    label = positive_label,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = leg_group_size,
    colour = positive_color,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = leg_arrow_x + 0.12,
    y = 0,
    label = negative_label,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = leg_group_size,
    colour = negative_color,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = leg_x - leg_w,
    y = 1.14,
    label = "NES",
    size = leg_title_size,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(leg_x - 0.60, leg_x + leg_xmax)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.06, 1.24), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

n_brk <- length(padj_breaks)
size_leg_df <- data.frame(
  x = leg_x,
  y = seq(0.16, 0.78, length.out = n_brk),
  size = sort(padj_breaks)
)

p_leg_size <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = size_leg_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, size = size),
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(0.8, 2.2),
    limits = c(0, padj_top),
    breaks = padj_breaks,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = size_leg_df,
    aes(x = leg_text_x, y = y, label = format(size)),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = leg_text_size,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = leg_x - 0.60,
    y = 0.98,
    label = expression(bold(-Log[10] ~ "(" * padj * ")")),
    size = leg_title_size,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(leg_x - 0.60, leg_x + leg_xmax)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.02, 1.06), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

p_left <- p_leg_size / p_leg_nes + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.1))
p_body <- ((p_left | p_ridge) + plot_layout(widths = c(0.34, 1))) &
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

p_final <- p_body +
  plot_annotation(
    title = title_main,
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = title_size,
        face = "bold",
        family = "Helvetica",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 2)
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
  )

dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (use_cairo) {
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    out_path,
    width = width_cm / 2.54,
    height = height_cm / 2.54,
    bg = "white",
    onefile = TRUE
  )
} else {
  grDevices::pdf(
    out_path,
    width = width_cm / 2.54,
    height = height_cm / 2.54,
    family = "Helvetica",
    paper = "special",
    encoding = "WinAnsi",
    useDingbats = FALSE,
    onefile = TRUE,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
print(p_final)
grDevices::dev.off()

cat("GSEA grouped ridge PDF written: ", out_path, "\n", sep = "")
cat("pathways=", nrow(meta), " rows=", nrow(d),
    " x_range=[", sprintf("%.1f", x_min), ", ",
    sprintf("%.1f", x_max), "]\n", sep = "")
